purpose: Deterministic, point-in-time method contract for a four-layer, five-timeframe theory challenger. This contract is not a trading authorization or a claim of market validity.

time_semantics.visibility_invariant: A bar is visible at decision_time if and only if is_closed is the exact JSON boolean true; source_timestamp, close_time, available_at, and decision_time are present, valid, timezone-aware, mutually comparable timestamps; and source_timestamp <= decision_time, close_time <= decision_time, and available_at <= decision_time. Any missing, malformed, incomparable timestamp or pseudo-boolean is_closed fails closed to DATA_INVALID and UNKNOWN_OR_ABSTAIN.
time_semantics.event_visibility_invariant: An event is visible at decision_time if and only if source_timestamp, published_at, available_at, and decision_time are present, valid, timezone-aware, mutually comparable timestamps; and source_timestamp <= decision_time, published_at <= decision_time, and available_at <= decision_time. source_timestamp records source provenance and is distinct from published_at, the public event publication time. Any missing, malformed, incomparable or future timestamp fails closed to DATA_INVALID and UNKNOWN_OR_ABSTAIN.
time_semantics.input_rule: Every input used at t must have source_timestamp <= t and available_at <= t; bar-derived input additionally requires is_closed=true and close_time <= t. The full visibility_invariant applies; pseudo-boolean is_closed and missing, malformed, or incomparable required timestamps fail closed.
time_semantics.event_order_rule: source_sequence is comparable only within the same (source_id,generation_id_or_stream_id). Cross-source equal-available_at records form a batch with no economic before/after; any non-exchangeable result is UNRESOLVED or STOP_FIRST. Canonical replay may apply a stable tie-break solely for serialization and it has no market-time meaning.
time_semantics.parent_bar_rule: The latest eligible parent bar is the latest bar satisfying the full visibility_invariant. No unclosed parent-bar field may be read.
time_semantics.state_rewrite_rule: Past state records are append-only and must not be recomputed using later data.
time_semantics.boundary_rule: All future DEVELOPMENT/CALIBRATION/HOLDOUT windows require chronological embargo at least as long as the frozen maximum feature lookback plus maximum holding horizon.
time_semantics.intrabar_rule: If OHLC is the finest admissible source and both barriers are touched in one bar, resolve FIRST_HIT as STOP_FIRST. No assumed path or fill is permitted.

record_identity_schema.comparison_rule: source_sequence is comparable only within the same source_id and generation_id_or_stream_id; different generations/streams are not sequence-comparable.
record_identity_schema.failure_rule: Missing, duplicate or conflicting required identity fails closed to DATA_INVALID and UNKNOWN_OR_ABSTAIN.
record_identity_schema.stable_input_id_rule: stable_input_id is only a canonical replay/serialization key and has no economic or market ordering meaning.

causal_measurement_contract.returns: r_t = log(close_t / close_{t-1}) for eligible closed bars only.
causal_measurement_contract.atr_scale: ATR_n(t) = causal ATR over the last n eligible closed bars; realized_vol_n(t) = sqrt(sum_{i=t-n+1}^t r_i^2). scale_t = max(ATR_n(t), close_t * realized_vol_n(t), epsilon).
causal_measurement_contract.directional_efficiency: de_n(t) = abs(close_t - close_{t-n}) / max(sum_{i=t-n+1}^t abs(close_i-close_{i-1}), epsilon).
causal_measurement_contract.non_overlapping_acceleration: a_n(t) = v_n(t) - v_n(t-n); the two velocity windows must not overlap. kinematics is ACCELERATING/STEADY/DECELERATING only by a frozen sign/threshold rule.
causal_measurement_contract.trailing_location: loc_t = (close_t - z_low) / max(z_high-z_low, epsilon) for frozen causal StructuralZone=[z_low,z_high], with a separately frozen extension band expressed in scale_t.

structural_regime_boolean.UP: v_n(t) >= theta_v AND de_n(t) >= theta_de AND this_timeframe_hysteresis_complete
structural_regime_boolean.DOWN: v_n(t) <= -theta_v AND de_n(t) >= theta_de AND this_timeframe_hysteresis_complete
structural_regime_boolean.RANGE: -theta_v < v_n(t) < theta_v AND de_n(t) < theta_de AND this_timeframe_hysteresis_complete
structural_regime_boolean.TRANSITION: DataQuality=VALID AND ((the remaining cross-region, including de_n >= theta_de with -theta_v < v_n < theta_v) OR this_timeframe_hysteresis_incomplete). Parent-child conflict belongs only to DecisionState.parent_child_relation and never rewrites a TFState regime.
structural_regime_boolean.UNKNOWN: candidate family is unfrozen, any required field/time proof is absent, or DataQuality is not VALID

causal_measurement_contract.parameter_domain: theta_v must be finite and >0; theta_de must be finite and 0<=theta_de<=1; normalized_velocity must be finite; directional_efficiency is finite and in [0,1]; n, hysteresis_length h and volatility_window are positive integers; epsilon is finite and >0; all bands/scales must be finite, ordered and nonnegative where applicable.
causal_measurement_contract.invalid_domain_rule: Any parameter-domain violation produces DATA_INVALID/UNKNOWN and StructuralRegime is not computed.

candidate_tuple_contract.band_rule: extension_band and central_range_band are finite nonnegative [lower,upper] pairs with lower<=upper; all scale-like values are finite and nonnegative.
candidate_tuple_contract.family_rule: Family length is 1..8, every tuple is exact-key complete and semantically unique after numeric normalization, and every tuple satisfies the full parameter and enum domain before any outcome access. Numerically equal encodings such as 1 versus 1.0 and -0.0 versus 0.0 are duplicates.

causal_measurement_contract.finite_candidate_family: Before any outcome access, choose at most eight complete valid tuples (n, theta_v, theta_de, extension_band, hysteresis_length, volatility_window, ATR_or_RV_choice, volume_baseline_method, weekday_or_session_adjustment, central_range_band, epsilon). No infinite/grid expansion, online update, result-conditioned replacement or parameter blending is permitted.
causal_measurement_contract.freeze_rule: If no complete pre-outcome candidate tuple is frozen, all measurement-dependent outputs are UNKNOWN.

TFState.definition: A point-in-time object for one eligible closed timeframe. TFState is never a single categorical label and StructuralRegime never contains DATA_INVALID.

field_semantics.DataQuality: VALID/STALE/GAP/CONFLICT/DATA_INVALID/UNKNOWN; DATA_INVALID is a data state, not a direction.
field_semantics.normalized_velocity: Frozen signed, volatility-normalized causal velocity estimate; no future extrema.
field_semantics.directional_efficiency: Frozen causal directional-path efficiency estimate, not a future trend score.
field_semantics.kinematics: ACCELERATING/STEADY/DECELERATING/UNKNOWN derived from causal velocity change.
field_semantics.trailing_location: Causal location relative to frozen structural zones and trailing range.
field_semantics.state_age: Count or duration since the current causal state began; no retrospective relabeling.

DecisionState.definition: The aggregated decision object containing the adjacent TFState chain, parent_child_relation, MacroCondition, LocalImpulse, CurrentPressureContext, data-quality rollup and provenance. It is the only object allowed to produce candidate Action.
DecisionState.fail_closed_rule: If any required TFState.DataQuality is not VALID (STALE, GAP, CONFLICT, DATA_INVALID or UNKNOWN), lacks time proof, or parent_child_relation is CONFLICT/UNKNOWN, DecisionState cannot produce a new EVALUATE_REVERSAL or EXECUTION_READY. This gate never suppresses higher-priority HALT, EXIT or MANAGE_ONLY for an existing position.

CurrentPressureContext.definition: Point-in-time observed current-market context: causal trades/order-flow when available, spread, visible capacity, funding, open interest, basis, realized volatility and data freshness. It contains no claim about intent, manipulation, sentiment truth or future price.

missingness_policy.trade: If a branch requires trade/order-flow confirmation and trade is missing/stale/gapped, that branch is UNKNOWN_OR_ABSTAIN.
missingness_policy.funding: Funding missingness cannot be imputed as neutral; funding-dependent branch is UNKNOWN_OR_ABSTAIN.
missingness_policy.open_interest: OI missingness cannot be inferred from price; OI-dependent branch is UNKNOWN_OR_ABSTAIN.
missingness_policy.basis: Basis missingness or contract mismatch is CONFLICT_OR_UNKNOWN, never a zero basis assumption.
missingness_policy.spread: Spread missingness blocks LiquidityFeasibleZone and forces ABSTAIN.
missingness_policy.depth: Depth gap/sequence break is DATA_INVALID for depth-dependent branches; visible depth is not guaranteed fill.
missingness_policy.realized_volatility: Volatility missingness blocks risk geometry and forces ABSTAIN.
missingness_policy.freshness: Any field older than its frozen freshness bound is STALE and blocks a branch requiring it.

MacroEvent.definition: A scheduled or released external datum with event_time, source_timestamp, published_at, available_at, vintage_id, actual_value_if_available, consensus_if_available and revision_status. source_timestamp is source provenance and is distinct from published_at, the public event publication time.
MacroEvent.forbidden_interpretation: No event narrative or revised value may be used as if it was available before its recorded available_at; the full event_visibility_invariant is required.

AnalogEpisode.definition: A past-only candidate episode retrieved from a frozen feature representation and search rule, with source end_time strictly before t minus embargo and with no target/outcome fields in the retrieval representation.

MarketScenario.definition: Pre-trade competing-market probability vector over UPSIDE, DOWNSIDE, RANGE and UNRESOLVED at a predeclared horizon. UNKNOWN is a model/data-invalid output, not a scenario class and does not participate in normalization.
MarketScenario.label_definition: For a frozen horizon H, frozen barriers B_up/B_down and frozen central_range_band defined before outcome access: UPSIDE/DOWNSIDE require a sortable valid event stream and respectively upper/lower barrier first; RANGE requires neither barrier by H plus terminal displacement and realized range inside central_range_band; UNRESOLVED is valid data with neither-first but failing RANGE, or both barriers in the same window without sequence proof. These four classes are mutually exclusive and exhaustive for valid data; UNKNOWN/DATA_INVALID are model/data-invalid outputs outside normalization.
MarketScenario.probability_scalar_rule: Every probability is a finite JSON number in [0,1]. JSON booleans true/false are not probability numbers and must fail closed.
MarketScenario.support_rule: If the state/branch support is below a predeclared minimum or calibration is not established, output UNKNOWN_OR_ABSTAIN rather than a directional probability claim.

ActionOutcome.definition: For each candidate action conditional on valid submission, a joint probability vector over NO_FILL, TP_FIRST, SL_FIRST, STRUCTURE_EXIT and TIMEOUT. It must sum to one or output UNKNOWN; it is not conditional-on-fill.
ActionOutcome.probability_scalar_rule: Every probability is a finite JSON number in [0,1]. JSON booleans true/false are not probability numbers and must fail closed.
ActionOutcome.fill_and_conditional_distribution: Report P(fill)=1-P(NO_FILL). For filled cohort outcomes, renormalize TP_FIRST/SL_FIRST/STRUCTURE_EXIT/TIMEOUT by their joint-probability sum; do not include NO_FILL in the conditional-on-fill distribution.
ActionOutcome.data_disposition: DataDisposition={VALID,CENSORED,DATA_INVALID,OPERATIONAL_OVERRIDE} is counted outside the probability vector. Invalid data or post-fill operational/risk override must fail closed and be reported, never silently deleted from the cohort.
ActionOutcome.post_fill_scoring_semantics: At submission freeze immutable five-branch prediction. Store observed_fill=true|false|null, observed_action_outcome=one_of_five_branches|null and DataDisposition separately. Score P(fill) only where observed_fill is non-null. Score five-branch joint Brier/log-loss only where exactly one terminal outcome is known. Score filled-cohort conditional distribution only where observed_fill=true and terminal outcome is known. CENSORED/DATA_INVALID/OPERATIONAL_OVERRIDE never rewrite prediction and never fabricate NO_FILL or a terminal outcome; missing labels are excluded only from the affected score denominator while disposition and pre/post-fill counts remain reported.
ActionOutcome.strict_record_validation: One shared validator runs before every denominator/count: observed_fill has exact JSON type boolean or null, so numeric pseudo-booleans 1/0/1.0/0.0 are rejected; observed_action_outcome has exact JSON type string and is one of NO_FILL/TP_FIRST/SL_FIRST/STRUCTURE_EXIT/TIMEOUT, or is null; NO_FILL requires observed_fill=false; a filled terminal requires observed_fill=true; unknown labels or contradictions are DATA_INVALID and never counted.
ActionOutcome.decision_rule: MarketScenario direction alone cannot authorize an order. Candidate action requires a cost-after expected-value lower confidence bound above the frozen no-trade or immediate-exit comparator, plus all risk and execution gates.

EntryZone.definition: A tick-aligned price interval satisfying all causal constraints at submission time.
EntryZone.state_permission_gate: StatePermissionGate={ALLOW,DENY} has no price coordinate. UNKNOWN/invalid data fails before the gate to UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN. Only ALLOW permits the four-coordinate intersection; DENY produces empty EntryZone and ABSTAIN. Any other gate value is rejected. State, macro and probabilities may not generate or move any price coordinate.

Action.definition: A single deterministic output selected from the action enum. RSI can only emit OBSERVE; it cannot emit EXECUTION_READY or an order by itself.

ExitPolicy.definition: A frozen initial stop, target set, maximum holding time and dynamic management ordering for one exact submission/fill cohort.
ExitPolicy.one_way_risk_rule: No update may increase worst-case loss, widen the protective stop, or extend maximum holding time.
ExitPolicy.target_lock_rule: PRE_LOCK target may be set only before submission from frozen geometry. POST_LOCK target may only remain frozen, tighten, partially realize or exit; it may never move farther solely because it is unfilled.

five_timeframe_roles.1w: Long-horizon risk context, exceptional extension and macro sensitivity only; never an entry trigger.
five_timeframe_roles.1d: Structural context and long-horizon zones only; never a 15m execution substitute.
five_timeframe_roles.4h: Only operational structural_regime and causal structural-zone source.
five_timeframe_roles.1h: Only setup, local impulse and impulse-change source.
five_timeframe_roles.15m: Only RSI OBSERVE trigger, current decision clock and execution-timing input.

parent_child_rules.aggregation: Each child may read only its adjacent eligible parent TFState; no skipped-parent override or weighted vote is permitted.
parent_child_rules.conflict: Parent conflict or UNKNOWN cannot be resolved by child voting and blocks only new EVALUATE_REVERSAL/EXECUTION_READY. It never suppresses higher-priority HALT, EXIT or MANAGE_ONLY for an existing position.
parent_child_rules.regime_authority: Only 4h may set operational structural_regime; 1w and 1d can veto risk but cannot create an entry; 1h and 15m cannot overwrite 4h.

state_transition_hysteresis.candidate_state: Compute the boolean StructuralRegime candidate from the frozen causal measurement tuple only.
state_transition_hysteresis.entry_rule: A new UP/DOWN/RANGE state requires the same eligible candidate for frozen h consecutive eligible bars; until then StructuralRegime=TRANSITION.
state_transition_hysteresis.exit_rule: An existing UP/DOWN/RANGE state remains only while its frozen retention condition holds; failure enters TRANSITION before any alternative state.
state_transition_hysteresis.age_rule: state_age starts at the first confirmed state bar and increments only on subsequent eligible bars of the same confirmed state.
state_transition_hysteresis.fail_closed: Only this-TF missing/non-VALID quality or unfrozen tuple prevents TFState confirmation and produces UNKNOWN. Parent-child invalid/conflict only makes DecisionState ABSTAIN and never rewrites any TFState.

mechanical_label_mapping.UP_DECELERATION: 4h.StructuralRegime=UP + 1h.kinematics=DECELERATING + directional_efficiency and state_age retained as separate axes
mechanical_label_mapping.DOWN_DECELERATION: 4h.StructuralRegime=DOWN + 1h.kinematics=DECELERATING + directional_efficiency and state_age retained as separate axes
mechanical_label_mapping.rule: POTENTIAL_BOTTOMING and POTENTIAL_TOPPING are observable candidates, not confirmed bottoms/tops or entry permissions. BREAKOUT_RISK defaults to ABSTAIN until an independently validated continuation branch exists.

four_layer_roles.L1_CURRENT_PRESSURE: Observed, time-stamped current market data; it may confirm, veto or force abstention but is not a weighted sentiment oracle.
four_layer_roles.L2_CYCLE_STATE: The five-timeframe TFState chain; it provides structural context and candidate classification, not a future label.
four_layer_roles.L3_HISTORICAL_ANALOG: Past-only, embargoed retrieval challenger with controls; it may not select outcomes or override causality.
four_layer_roles.L4_MACRO_EVENT: Point-in-time event/vintage risk context; initially a risk/conflict gate, not a directional news predictor.
four_layer_roles.combination_rule: Layers retain separate provenance, missingness and falsification. No unfrozen weighted score, narrative agreement score or unrestricted feature fusion is allowed.

price_and_risk_geometry.price_coordinates: All price coordinates originate from a frozen causal StructuralZone=[z_low,z_high], tick-aligned venue rules and decision-time liquidity/risk constraints; no hand-drawn level is admissible.

initial_formulae.entry: if StatePermissionGate=ALLOW then entry in EntryZone = StructuralZone intersect LiquidityFeasibleZone intersect RiskGeometryZone intersect VenueRuleZone; otherwise EntryZone=empty and ABSTAIN
initial_formulae.target_long: TP0_long = tick_align_up(entry + frozen_reward_multiple * (entry - SL0_long)) or frozen causal structural target, whichever is predeclared
initial_formulae.target_short: TP0_short = tick_align_down(entry - frozen_reward_multiple * (SL0_short - entry)) or frozen causal structural target, whichever is predeclared
initial_formulae.size: q0 = min(risk_budget / abs(entry - SL0), venue_max_size, causal_liquidity_cap); if q0 violates venue/capacity/risk constraints then ABSTAIN

dynamic_formulae.remaining_ev_exit: EXIT when LCB(EV_hold_remaining | exact_fill_cohort, DecisionState_t) <= EV_immediate_exit_after_cost, subject to frozen estimator and support gate

cross_cutting_probability_measurement.scope: This is a horizontal measurement requirement for every hypothesis that emits MarketScenario or ActionOutcome probabilities; it is not an L1 hypothesis and does not combine layers.
cross_cutting_probability_measurement.fail_closed_rule: Insufficient state support, failed normalization, missing pre-outcome calibration plan or failed calibration produces UNKNOWN_OR_ABSTAIN, never a directional action.

event_sequence_candidate.clock: Daily sequence state updates only after that day's is_closed=true, close_time <= decision_time and available_at <= decision_time. A later state must never rewrite an earlier daily record.

daily_anatomy.robust_volume_baseline: logV_d=log(max(volume_d,epsilon)); robust_vol_score_d=(logV_d-rolling_median_n(logV))/max(MAD_n(logV),epsilon), or a separately frozen EWMA baseline. Mean/standard-deviation is not the only admissible baseline.
daily_anatomy.new_high_low: new_high/new_low use trailing eligible closed highs/lows only; no same-day or future lookahead.

event_sequence_candidate.news_event: Macro/news event fields are event_time, published_at, available_at, vintage_id and revision_status. Narrative direction is not an observable field.

data_universe.pooling_rule: Any mismatch in asset_class, venue, market_type, instrument_id, contract_specification, session_timezone, daily_boundary, volume_unit or price_adjustment_policy must not pool into one cohort; use a separately registered stratum or fail DATA_INVALID.
data_universe.equity: Require split/dividend adjustment policy, halt/suspension and limit-up/limit-down handling, and free-float turnover semantics where used.
data_universe.crypto: Require 24/7 day boundary/session timezone, base-vs-quote volume definition, multi-venue divergence treatment, contract migration/delisting handling, index methodology and stablecoin-event handling.

event_sequence_candidate.prefix_anchor_protocol: For each daily bar D1..D8, anchor t_k is that bar's close_time/available_at. Freeze only prefix D1..Dk state, probabilities and Action at t_k; reveal next-day and predeclared 1-3 day outcomes only after their availability. The full D1..D8 episode may predict D9 onward only and must never filter the sample for D1..D7 prefix tests.

pre_registered_prefix_assertions.D2_D3: Test whether compression/responsive-buying prefixes add information about subsequent 1-3 day UPWARD_EXPANSION price outcome against prefix-matched simple OHLCV shock and time/regime controls.
pre_registered_prefix_assertions.D6_D7: Test whether failed-continuation/distribution-candidate prefixes add information about next-day downside/breakdown outcomes, against prefix-matched simple OHLCV shock and time/regime controls.

event_sequence_candidate.nested_prefix_rule: All D1..D8 prefixes from a candidate episode are one episode cluster for split, bootstrap and multiple-comparison accounting. No full-episode outcome selection, overlap leakage or prefix reuse across train/test roles is permitted.
event_sequence_candidate.unknown_action_rule: UNKNOWN is permitted only for invalid, missing or unfrozen required inputs; valid evaluated states use OBSERVE, ABSTAIN or EVALUATE_REVERSAL.
event_sequence_candidate.action_boundary: All states use exactly UNKNOWN/OBSERVE/ABSTAIN/EVALUATE_REVERSAL. Never auto-order, never chase event expansion, and never merge long exit with new short; short requires a separately authorized new episode.
event_sequence_candidate.risk_boundary: Existing long may only manage/exit under the frozen one-way ExitPolicy. Any future short has separate EntryZone, stop, target, horizon, cohort and permission.

cohort_contract.pooling_rule: Any mismatch in this exact key set must not pool into the same cohort; use a separately registered stratum or fail DATA_INVALID.

rsi_lifecycle.identity_and_eligibility: episode_id and immutable creation record identify whether an episode has ever existed. active is lifecycle persistence; eligible_for_upgrade is separate and remains false at creation and on the same bar, becoming true only for a strictly later eligible closed bar after every upgrade gate passes.
rsi_lifecycle.new_observe_emitted: Boolean, separate from Action. It is true exactly once only when cross_valid=true, DataQuality=VALID, parent state/relation valid, all candidate gates pass and terminal=false create a new episode; persistent extreme keeps it false.
rsi_lifecycle.creation_action: A new cross creates episode_id and Action=OBSERVE only when all creation gates pass; an invalid-data, invalid-parent, failed-candidate-gate or terminal cross creates no episode and returns fail-closed Action.
rsi_lifecycle.upgrade: A later-bar upgrade can only be Action=EVALUATE_REVERSAL and requires active=true, eligible_for_upgrade=true, unexpired=true, a strictly later eligible closed decision bar, DataQuality=VALID, valid parent state/relation, all candidate gates pass, and no terminal action.
rsi_lifecycle.forbidden_upgrade: Same-bar, expired, non-VALID quality, parent invalid/UNKNOWN, or terminal episodes cannot upgrade to EVALUATE_REVERSAL or EXECUTION_READY.
rsi_lifecycle.dedup_expiry_termination: Persistent extreme does not repeat emission. Frozen expiry, data-quality failure, parent invalidation, or terminal action sets active=false and eligible_for_upgrade=false while retaining immutable episode identity/record. An existing inactive record without termination proof returns UNKNOWN with LIFECYCLE_PROOF_MISSING. Other missing dedup/expiry/termination proof fails closed to ABSTAIN without suppressing required HALT/EXIT/MANAGE_ONLY.

P0_venue_market_data.name: Binance developer documentation
P0_venue_market_data.use: schema, event and venue-rule feasibility only

P2_low_frequency_independent_candidate.name: CFTC
P2_low_frequency_independent_candidate.use: official low-frequency report timing feasibility only

source_contract.macro_direction_model: P1 only: any macro direction/probability model requires a separate hypothesis, comparator and future authorization; P0 macro sources are risk point-in-time feasibility only.
source_contract.rule: All listed sources are source/schema/timing feasibility evidence only. They are not market validation, alpha evidence, permission to download outcomes or permission to backtest.
